newsitem.title: USA: Western Pacific sees soft yields.
newsitem.headline: Western Pacific sees soft yields.

text.p: Western Pacific Airlines Inc said on Tuesday it was still seeing soft yields but it believed its previously announced entry into Denver would improve yields and load factor in the future.
Passenger load factors in April rose to 63.3 percent from 55.2 percent in April last year, it said.

"We expect to see improving financial results in coming quarters as we accelerate our progress towards changing the strategic direction of the airline," Western Pacific President and Chief Executive Officer Robert Peiser said.
Starting June 29, the company said it planned to operate 45 average daily departures from Denver International Airport to cities across the United States.
